## Activities

- {{< iconify fa6-solid people-line size=18px >}} **Monday and Wednesday**: Course introduction
- {{< iconify fa6-solid people-line size=18px >}} **Friday**: Course introduction
- {{< iconify fa6-solid diagram-project size=18px >}} **Friday**: Laboratory session
  - Introduction to the computer security course
  - Highlighting the concept of a security synapse
  - Setup all software on student laptops
  - Presentation of a computer security article
    - *Options for your article*:
      - Popular press article that explains a security incident
      - Technical article that explains a computer security concept
      - Research paper that introduces new theory or practice in computer security
